dineIn.answer: Dine-in, counter and drive-thru orders all start from the QR code at the store: scan the code on your table or at the counter to browse the menu, pick your items and pay—no line required.
dineIn.question: How do I order when dining in?

invoice.answer: At checkout you can choose a paper invoice, mobile barcode carrier, citizen digital certificate, company tax ID or donation; the e-invoice is issued according to your choice.
invoice.question: Can I get an e-invoice or a company invoice?

payment.answer: Online pickup orders accept credit cards, Apple Pay, JKOPAY, iPASS MONEY, WeChat Pay and TWQR mobile payments. Cash is only accepted in store.
payment.question: Which payment methods are supported?

pickup.answer: Choose a store, pick your items and pay online, then show your pickup number at the store at your chosen time. You can follow the progress on the pickup board.
pickup.question: How does pickup work?

points.answer: Once signed in, every purchase earns points automatically. Points can be redeemed for coupons to use at checkout, and are valid for one year from the day they are earned. We'll email you 30 days before any points expire.
points.question: How do I earn and use points?

waitlist.answer: Scan the waitlist QR code at the store and enter your party size to take a number. Leave an email to be notified when it's your turn, or check the progress on the calling board anytime.
waitlist.question: How do I join the waitlist when the store is full?
